sonicrec.title: Fly by Sound: recording
sonicrec.status.asking: Waiting for the pilot to agree: press T again, or use Start recording.
sonicrec.status.starting: Starting. If the browser asks for the microphone, choose Allow.
sonicrec.status.closing: Stopping. A survey may be running.
sonicrec.status.finishing: Finishing the recording on this device.
sonicrec.voice.denied: Voice: the microphone was not allowed, so only the flight is recorded.
sonicrec.voice.unavailable: Voice: there is no microphone, or this browser cannot record it, so only the flight is recorded.
sonicrec.voice.failed: Voice: the recording of the voice stopped.
sonicrec.consent.title: Before recording
sonicrec.consent.text: The flight and, if the browser allows the microphone, the pilot's voice are recorded on this device only. Nothing is sent to anyone until the pilot agrees to send it, in a separate step.
sonicrec.consent.agree: The pilot agrees to this recording.
sonicrec.pilot.title: The pilot
sonicrec.pilot.guardian: A parent or guardian has signed the consent form, and I confirm it
sonicrec.pilot.guardian.help: Without this the recording stays on this device and cannot be sent.
sonicrec.sessions.title: Recordings on this device
sonicrec.state.unfinished: Not finished: the page was closed or crashed during it.
sonicrec.msg.kept: Kept. It is a recording that ended early; it can be saved to disk or sent.
sonicrec.msg.recorded: The recording is saved on this device. Save it to disk too.
sonicrec.note.persist: The browser may clear this storage when the disk is nearly full. Save recordings to disk.
sonicrec.note.memory: This browser cannot keep recordings safe: a closed tab loses them. Save each recording to disk right after it ends.
sonicrec.error.mode-off: The sound mode is not running, so nothing was recorded.
sonicrec.error.storage-low: Only {free} MB of browser storage are left and {need} MB are needed, so nothing was recorded. Free some space, or save the old recordings and delete them.
sonicrec.error.voice-start: The voice could not be recorded: {reason}
sonicrec.error.voice-write: The voice could not be written: {reason}
sonicrec.error.voice-stop: The voice recorder did not stop cleanly: {reason}
sonicrec.error.finish: The recording could not be finished: {reason}
sonicrec.reason.locked: another tab is recording this session
sonicrec.reason.cannot-pack: the recording is damaged and cannot be packed
sonicrec.reason.recover: it could not be brought back
sonicrec.survey.title: Fly by Sound: a few questions
sonicrec.survey.listening: Listening: say your answer out loud, then press {key}.
sonicrec.replay.title: Replay a recording
sonicrec.replay.loading: Opening the recording and checking it against the lesson. The flight stays as it is until you press Play.
sonicrec.replay.check.pass: The replay agrees with the recording: {matched} of {recorded} events were worked out again, and {cues} % of the sounds are the same.
sonicrec.replay.check.fail: The replay differs from the recording in {diffs} event(s): {matched} of {recorded} recorded events were worked out again, and {cues} % of the sounds are the same. It is still played as it was recorded.
sonicrec.replay.noruntime: Replay needs the sound mode to be running. Start a lesson first, then open the recording.
sonicrec.replay.problems: The file has {n} problem(s). What can be read is replayed.
sonicrec.replay.voice.failed: The voice could not be decoded by this browser, so only the flight is replayed.
sonicrec.replay.world.other: The picture shows another place than the recording was flown in. The sounds and the voice are exact.
sonicrec.replay.busy: Stop the recording before you replay one.
sonicrec.send.heading: Send this recording to the author?
sonicrec.send.consent.text: The whole recording is sent: the flight and, if there is one, the pilot's voice. It goes to the author of Fly by Sound by Telegram and by e-mail. The server keeps it for the project for at most five years, or less if the pilot or a parent asks for it to be deleted. The copy on this device stays where it is.
sonicrec.send.consent.agree: The pilot agrees to send this recording, with the voice.
sonicrec.send.consent.minor: For a pilot under 18, the parent or guardian has signed the consent form and this is recorded in the recording.
sonicrec.send.notice.nothing: There is no finished recording to send.
sonicrec.send.notice.busy-recording: A recording is running. Stop it first.
sonicrec.send.notice.asked: Asked the pilot to agree to send the recording. Press U again to agree, or use Send.
sonicrec.send.notice.cancelled: Not sent. The recording stays on this device.
sonicrec.send.notice.guardian: This recording cannot be sent: a parent's signed consent was not confirmed when it was recorded.
sonicrec.send.notice.unfinished: Keep the interrupted recording first, then send it.
sonicrec.send.notice.unreadable: This recording cannot be read, so it cannot be sent.
sonicrec.send.notice.locked: This recording is being made in another tab.
sonicrec.send.notice.other-tab: Another tab of this browser is already sending this recording.
sonicrec.send.notice.already: This recording has already been delivered to the author.
sonicrec.send.notice.started: Sending started. The recording stays on this device.
sonicrec.send.notice.resumed: Sending of an earlier recording goes on.
sonicrec.transfer.waiting: Not sent yet ({problem}). It stays on this device. Trying again at {time}.
sonicrec.transfer.waiting.soon: Not sent yet ({problem}). It stays on this device. Trying again soon.
sonicrec.transfer.interrupted: Sending was interrupted. It goes on at the next start, or press Try again now.
sonicrec.transfer.stored: The server has it. Delivery to the author: {channels}.
sonicrec.transfer.stored.trouble: The server has it. The delivery cannot be read now ({problem}).
sonicrec.channel.name: {name}: {status}
sonicrec.channel.status.link: a link was sent, the file is too big for it
sonicrec.channel.status.failed: did not work, the author can send it again
sonicrec.problem.other: the server answered with a fault: {code}
sonicrec.blocked.consent-guardian: a parent's signed consent was not confirmed when it was recorded. Record again after ticking the guardian box.
sonicrec.blocked.too-large: the recording is bigger than the server accepts.
sonicrec.blocked.not-a-package: the server says this is not a Fly by Sound recording.
sonicrec.blocked.gone: the server no longer has it (the author may have deleted it). It is safe on this device; send it again if you want to.
sonicrec.blocked.token: the server lost track of this upload.
sonicrec.blocked.unknown: the server keeps forgetting this upload. Try again later.
sonicrec.blocked.no-consent: the pilot has not agreed to send it.
sonicrec.pilot.speech: Voice commands: the pilot can say 'send it to the author'
sonicrec.pilot.speech.help: Uses the browser's speech recognition, which sends the audio to the browser's maker (for Chrome, Google). Off until you tick it. The keys always work. Nothing is listened to while a recording runs.
sonicrec.pilot.speech.unavailable: This browser has no speech recognition.
sonicrec.pilot.speech.guardian: A pilot under 18 needs the guardian's confirmation first.
sonicrec.voice.phrases.send: send it to the author|send it|send my flight|send the flight|send the recording
